title: Godly Speech
definition: Godly Speech is the use of words in ways that honor God, tell truth, build others up, and reflect a renewed heart.
summary: The tongue should come under the lordship of Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ speaks truth and grace, and He teaches His disciples to use words for life rather than destruction.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Godly Speech describes a Spirit-formed pattern of life for those who belong to Jesus Christ. Christian living is not an attempt to earn salvation but the grateful response of people who have been saved by grace and called to walk with the Lord.

Scripture presents this truth so believers can grow in holiness, endurance, love, wisdom, worship, and mission. It touches the heart, the mind, the tongue, relationships, daily habits, and faithful obedience in ordinary life.

The emphasis of this doctrine is the tongue should come under the lordship of christ.. It points disciples away from self-reliance and toward abiding dependence on Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because discipleship can become shallow when it is reduced to information, emotion, or outward activity alone. Godly Speech teaches believers how grace becomes visible in daily conduct, perseverance, relationships, and obedience to Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask the Lord to form this truth in you through Scripture, prayer, repentance, and faithful practice. Let godly speech shape how you think, speak, serve, endure, forgive, and represent Christ in the places God has assigned to you.
